messages:
Avery (Sales): Quick handoff — Silverpine Labs signed MSA late last night. Key contacts: Elena (CTO) & Marco (Infra). They asked for VPC peering + Okta SCIM and want Dedicated capacity ~6 weeks out. Baseline ~2.7M tokens/mo; burst up to ~5.2M. Renewal in 11 months. Procurement historically slow — recommend setting renewal-watch if PO not in by 21 days. Passing to CS for onboarding and to Eng/Support for infra/runbook prep.

Noel (CS): Taking point. I will schedule a 30m tech intake with Elena/Marco. Need billing contact, sample prompts, and a short list of priority flows (chat, batch embeddings, webhook). Also any compliance constraints? They mentioned "data residency EU" in the contract.

Avery (Sales): Billing contact is Omar (RevOps) — cc'd. Sample prompts and eval notes here: https://drive.redwood/silverpine-examples. Model: redwood/llama-8b-quant (checkpoint ~10.2GB post-quant). Peak concurrency estimate: 42 rps. Seq len: chat~512, embeddings batch up to 2048.

Ravi (Eng): I can do VPC/peering + SSO feasibility check. ETA: 3 business days for initial precheck and risk notes. I need: test CIDR, allowed egress ports, a contact who manages their terraform/state, and preferred GPU family (A100 vs A10). Ill include GPU-hour and memory footprint estimates for procurement. Recommend canary ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 4 days.

Hana (Support): Ill draft the onboarding runbook and incident playbook. Starting checklist:
```
preflight:
  - confirm peering & route tables
  - SCIM user provisioning test
monitoring:
  - p95 latency < 350ms (chat)
  - 5xx < 0.75%
escalation:
  - cs-oncall -> eng-oncall -> infra-owner
```
Ill push v1 to the shared kickoff doc by EOD Fri. Also recommend a joint runbook drill with their oncall in week 2 (simulate latency spike + failover).

Omar (RevOps): Procurement note: PO ETA currently 2-3 weeks but can slip. Ill prioritize and surface SOC2 + DPA questions. Will tag renewal-risk if PO not received in 21 days.

scheduler-bot: Meeting created: Mon 10:30am CET "Silverpine technical intake" (invitees: Avery, Noel, Ravi, Hana, Elena).

Noel (CS): Drafting kickoff doc now with sections: owners & due dates, success criteria, risk register, enablement plan. Proposed owners: Noel (CS lead), Ravi (Eng precheck), Hana (Support runbook), Omar (RevOps billing). Proposed deadlines: precheck in 3bd, runbook draft in 4bd, kickoff Mon.

Avery (Sales): FYI they asked about 24/7 support and audit log retention (12 months). That could impact SLA/price — flag for AM.

Ravi (Eng): Noted. Ill include fallback policy (hosted compat model) if dedicated capacity isn't available at launch, and recommended autoscaling targets. Avery  can you confirm expected sustained QPS vs burst?

Avery (Sales): Sustained ~25 rps, burst up to 42 rps for short periods. Added to the doc.

Hana (Support): I added a short "what to log" snippet for their engineers (trace_id, request_id, model_id, latency_ms) to speed triage. Also adding escalation contact rotation.

Noel (CS): Summary Ill paste into kickoff doc and invite:
- Owners: Noel (CS), Ravi (Eng), Hana (Support), Omar (RevOps), Avery (Sales)
- Deliverables & ETA: infra precheck (3bd), runbook draft (4bd), kickoff Mon 10:30am CET
- Success criteria: p95 <350ms chat, 5xx <0.75%, PO in 21 days or escalate to AM/RevOps
- Enablement: runbook drill wk2, 30d feedback + short NPS touch after 30 days

Omar (RevOps): Ill watch PO lane and update here if procurement needs longer. If PO exceeds 21 days Ill tag renewal-risk and loop AM.

Noel (CS): Great. Ill update this thread after kickoff with the finalized runbook link and owners. Closing loop for now :thumbsup:
